question: Do the two legs of a same-game side+total ticket move together?
basis: Phi on the 2x2 of leg outcomes, walk-forward games where both legs qualified
sign_convention: Positive = legs reinforce; negative = one leg tends to cancel the other. Observed 2x2: both=5, side only=11, total only=5, neither=3

question: Can a spread leg and a moneyline leg on the same team disagree?
basis: Definitional bound, not a sample estimate: both are increasing functions of the same margin
sign_convention: A home cover and a home win always agree when the spread is negative; they can disagree only when the spread underdog wins outright. Not an estimate - a bound.

leg_pair: side error x total error (same game)
question: Are this model's side and total errors correlated, which would make a same-game ticket riskier or safer than the product of its legs?
basis: Pearson r on walk-forward residuals (actual - model) of the two legs
sign_convention: Near zero means the independence shortcut is defensible for THIS model; a large value means joint pricing must use a copula or the empirical 2x2.

leg_pair: side x side (different games, different teams)
question: Are two unrelated games' results correlated?
basis: No shared players, venue or weather; treated as independent by construction
sign_convention: This is an assumption, stated as an assumption, not a measurement. It is the one correlation in this table that is NOT estimated from data.

leg_pair: player prop x player prop (same game)
question: Do two player props in the same game move together (e.g. QB passing yards and WR receiving yards)?
basis: Needs per-player official game logs for every participant
sign_convention: Not computed. NFL.com publishes per-player game logs, but this repository holds no player-level game series (F31), so no value is inferred.

leg_pair: player prop x game total (same game)
question: Does a player prop move with the game total?
basis: Needs per-player official game logs plus a graded prop threshold
sign_convention: Not computed for the same reason as X05. A threshold must also be chosen and pre-registered before any prop can be graded.
